article: Add a Border to an Image in paint.net
scope: Compared the complete Japanese article and twelve translations, canvas-size operation, exact border arithmetic, paint.net 5.1/5.1.1 behavior change, screenshots, metadata, and official documentation.
findings: Removed duplicate future dates, retained 2023-04-11, and set lastmod to 2026-11-24.
Corrected the assumption that secondary color automatically fills new canvas areas: paint.net 5.1 changed Background-layer expansion to transparent, and 5.1.1 added explicit Fill selection.
Added Fill > Secondary Color to all languages and removed the obsolete Canvas Size screenshot.
Confirmed centered border arithmetic: add twice the desired thickness to both width and height.
